description: Retained October13 Nadia opening and correction to three walnut workstations for twelve people; quotation stays declined.

turns.text: Hi, I’m Nadia. We’re furnishing a new office in Dubai for four people. Can you help us choose the furniture?
We’re considering two LUMA 9719-4 workstations in walnut for eight people. Our furniture budget is AED 6,000. Don’t prepare a quotation yet.
Do you provide delivery and assembly in Dubai?
Update: we now need places for twelve people, so three four-person workstations. Keep the walnut finish and the same budget. Please summarise the updated requirements.

checks.description: Supported general need and matching multiple named units must not receive an exact-match caveat.
Requested updated summary states actual current quantities, model, finish, headcount and retained budget.
